name: Benchmark Library of Mixed-Integer Optimal Control Problems
description: A library of mixed-integer optimal control problem instances intended to evaluate and compare solvers on correctness, performance, and scalability.
reputation: A specialized academic benchmark library used in the optimal control and numerical optimization research communities for solver comparison.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; solver performance measured by objective quality and runtime; results vary widely by problem instance and solver tuning; risk of solver-specific overfitting/parameter tuning.
